content.text:
There are **9,675 days** between February 12, 2024 and August 9, 2050.

Wolfram|Alpha returned 9675 days, and I checked it by hand: 26 years contain 9,497 days (9,490 plus 7 leap days, from 2024 through 2048), and February 12 to August 9, 2050 adds 178 more.
